steps.name: project-init
steps.summary: Next 16 + TS strict + Tailwind 4 scaffold (package.json, tsconfig, next.config, postcss, eslint v9 flat, prettier, .nvmrc, app/globals.css 빈 베이스) 생성, npm install 완료

steps.name: app-shell
steps.summary: RootLayout(lang=ko, class=dark, theme-color #0a0a0a, Pretendard fallback chain), 홈 placeholder, 404 not-found, globals.css에 @theme tokens + typing-dot keyframes 추가; lint/tsc/build 통과

steps.name: shadcn-ui
steps.summary: shadcn/ui new-york style 초기화 (components.json, lib/utils.ts) + 13개 컴포넌트(button/input/textarea/select/label/sheet/popover/scroll-area/carousel/form/radio-group/card/sonner) 생성, lucide-react/cva 의존성 추가, ESLint override(components/ui/** react-hooks/set-state-in-effect off); lint/tsc/build 통과

steps.name: hono-mount
steps.summary: Hono 4.12 의존성 추가, Edge runtime 라우트(app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts: GET /api/health, POST /api/chat 501)와 Node runtime 라우트(app/api/node/[[...route]]/route.ts: GET /api/node/health, POST /api/node/feedback 501, POST /api/node/contact 501) 분리 마운트; tsc/lint/build 통과, AC curl 6종 모두 정상 응답

steps.name: spec-validation
steps.summary: lib/spec-schema.ts (zod 4 schema covering all 14 top-level spec.json keys, ID regex IDs FEAT/Q/TS/ERR/EC), lib/spec-loader.ts (Node-only fs cached loader), scripts/validate-spec.ts (CLI: schema + duplicate ID check + dependency/feature ref integrity + --strict-tests opt-in file existence). package.json: tsx@^4 devDep + check:spec script + prebuild hook. Positive: 29 features/18 questions/70 scenarios/27 errors/50 edge cases validated; negative test exit 1 with path-prefixed messages; tsc/lint/build all green.

steps.name: test-setup
steps.summary: Vitest 4 + jsdom + Testing Library + msw 2 + Playwright 1.59 골격 구축. vitest.config.ts(coverage 70% threshold, components/ui 제외), tests/setup.ts(jest-dom, matchMedia/scrollTo/ResizeObserver mock, msw onUnhandledRequest:error), tests/msw/{server,handlers}.ts(빈 핸들러 배열), playwright.config.ts(6 디바이스 프로젝트 + viewport override + testMatch /.*\.e2e\.ts$/ + webServer port 3100), specs/spec-schema.spec.ts smoke + tests/e2e/smoke.e2e.ts(home title/lang/dark + /api/health). package.json: test/test:watch/test:coverage/e2e/e2e:ui scripts + 9개 devDeps. Playwright chromium+webkit 브라우저 설치 완료. tsc/lint/build/vitest 모두 통과, e2e MacBook 13 smoke 2/2 pass.
